108fe459: What is the name of the team made up of Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura?
Team 7, led by Kakashi Hatake, is the main team of the series.
afda906b: Which clan does Sasuke belong to?
The Uchiha clan is famous for its Sharingan and its mastery of fire.
467c9d2c: What is the name of the nine-tailed fox sealed inside Naruto?
Kurama, the Nine-Tails, is the most powerful of the nine tailed beasts. It was sealed inside Naruto at birth.
27471fbc: The Rasengan is a spinning sphere of chakra invented by the Fourth Hokage, Naruto's father.
1418b32a: Minato Namikaze, the Fourth Hokage, is Naruto's father. He sacrificed himself to seal Kurama.
ca6f5295: Hiruzen Sarutobi, the Third Hokage, is called “the Professor” because he knows every jutsu of the Leaf Village.
de017843: Which clan does Hinata belong to?
The Hyūga clan is known for its Byakugan, an eye that can see in 360° and reveal chakra points.
bbff87e6: Which character uses the Mangekyō Sharingan?
Itachi Uchiha has the Mangekyō Sharingan, awakened after a traumatic experience.
9ac9f8e2: What is the secret technique of the Nara clan?
The Nara clan masters shadow jutsu, especially the Shadow Possession Jutsu, to immobilize enemies.
8eee3e85: Who founded the Hidden Leaf Village?
Hashirama Senju and Madara Uchiha founded the Leaf Village together, despite their rivalry.
2939b343: What is the name of Itachi's jutsu that traps the victim in a 72-hour illusion?
Tsukuyomi is an extremely powerful genjutsu that distorts the victim's perception of time.
66353619: In which country is the Hidden Leaf Village?
Konoha, the Village Hidden in the Leaves, is located in the Land of Fire.
2e04eadd: Which ninja rank comes right above Genin?
The ninja hierarchy is: Academy → Genin → Chūnin → Jōnin → Special Jōnin / Anbu → Kage.
4ffefbf4: What did Kakashi inherit from his friend Obito?
Dying, Obito gives his left eye to Kakashi. This Sharingan later lets Kakashi use Kamui. The Chidori, on the other hand, is a technique Kakashi invented.
c5b9753c: Tobi turns out to be Obito Uchiha, Kakashi's former teammate believed to have died in the Third Great Ninja War.
d0c3d69d: How many tails does the beast sealed inside Gaara have?
Shukaku, the tailed beast sealed inside Gaara, is the One-Tail. Gaara is its jinchūriki.
2c9b11d4: What is the Akatsuki's main goal?
The Akatsuki seeks to capture the nine tailed beasts to create a weapon of mass destruction.
de2dc2d4: What is the name of Sasuke's ultimate technique with his Susanoo?
Indra's Arrow is the ultimate technique of Sasuke's Susanoo, an arrow made of concentrated lightning chakra.
e3b4d05e: Who is the puppet master of the Sand Village?
Kankurō is the puppet master of the Hidden Sand Village and Gaara's older brother.
26bcac79: Who was the sensei of Kakashi, Obito and Rin?
Minato Namikaze (the Fourth Hokage) was the former sensei of Kakashi, Obito and Rin.
f01dd778: What is the full name of Naruto's improved Rasengan technique?
The Rasenshuriken combines the Rasengan with wind nature, creating a blade of microscopic chakra.
2104a48e: Sakura is trained by Tsunade and becomes one of the best medical ninja, mastering healing chakra.
39a65a41: Which village is led by the Mizukage?
Kirigakure, the Village Hidden in the Mist, is led by the Mizukage. Zabuza grew up there.
7f209d3e: Which Uchiha used Izanami on Kabuto?
Itachi uses Izanami on Kabuto to break his artificial personality and stop the Impure World Reincarnation.
b1410988: What is the name of the Impure World Reincarnation technique?
Edo Tensei (Impure World Reincarnation) brings the dead back to life in clay bodies.
b84eca8f: Who invented the Impure World Reincarnation jutsu?
Tobirama Senju, the Second Hokage, invented Edo Tensei. Orochimaru later perfected it.
3f5e413b: Which hidden village is associated with the Raikage?
Kumogakure, the Village Hidden in the Clouds, is led by the Raikage and is known for its lightning ninja.
3f629cb5: Which arm is Naruto missing at the end of the series?
Naruto loses his right arm in his final fight against Sasuke. It is replaced by a prosthetic arm.
24f50649: What is the name of the Two-Tailed Beast?
Matatabi, the two-tailed nekomata, is a giant cat made of blue flames. Its jinchūriki is Yugito Nii.
6af21d39: What is the maximum number of tomoe a Sharingan can have?
The Sharingan can have up to three tomoe. It then evolves into the Mangekyō Sharingan.
5cabd106: Tsunade, a former student of the Third Hokage, becomes the Fifth Hokage after the Third's death.
eb924767: What is the real name of Konoha?
Konoha means “leaf” in Japanese. The full name is Konohagakure no Sato (Village Hidden in the Leaves).
a94c082c: What is the kekkei genkai of the Hyūga clan?
The Byakugan is the Hyūga clan's eye, giving near-360° vision and the ability to see chakra points.
f6c69d22: The Fourth Kazekage, Rasa, is Gaara's father. He sealed Shukaku inside him while he was still in his mother's womb.
95f018cd: Which fighting style does Rock Lee use exclusively?
Rock Lee cannot use ninjutsu or genjutsu. He makes up for it by perfecting taijutsu beyond every limit.
d032ff5c: What is Nagato's alias in the Akatsuki?
Nagato goes by the name “Pain” and controls six bodies (the Six Paths of Pain) through the chakra rods he plants in them.
89799193: In which country is the Sand Village?
Sunagakure, the Village Hidden in the Sand, is in the Land of Wind, in the middle of the desert.
e80079d9: What is the name of Itachi's father, who leads the Uchiha clan?
Fugaku Uchiha, head of the Uchiha clan and father of Itachi and Sasuke, was planning a coup against the Leaf Village.
5a07d33a: Which of the Sannin specializes in snake techniques?
Orochimaru specializes in snake techniques, forbidden experiments and the search for immortality.
fb861fde: How many people are in the Akatsuki?
The Akatsuki has ten active members working in pairs. The best-known pairs are Itachi/Kisame and Deidara/Sasori.
ec038ef5: Who is the jinchūriki of the Eight-Tailed Beast?
Killer Bee, the Raikage's brother, is the jinchūriki of Gyūki, the Eight-Tails shaped like a horned octopus.
5a4f4d02: What is the name of Naruto's mode that uses natural energy?
Sage Mode (Sennin Mode), learned on Mount Myōboku, lets Naruto use natural energy.
7bb576d0: What is Madara's real goal with the Infinite Tsukuyomi?
Plunge the world into a perfect illusion
The Infinite Tsukuyomi is the Eye of the Moon Plan: trapping all of humanity in an endless, idyllic dream.
1a9074e1: What is Asuma Sarutobi's signature ninja tool?
Asuma uses chakra blades that channel his wind chakra.
d280fab6: Which clan does Shino belong to?
From birth, the Aburame clan bonds with Kikaichū insects that live in their bodies and obey their orders.
32be7a55: What is Zabuza Momochi's home village?
Zabuza comes from the Village Hidden in the Mist (Kirigakure). He was one of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist.
6e247851: What is the name of Zabuza's sword?
Zabuza's Kubikiribōchō (the Executioner's Blade) is a huge cleaver-shaped sword that can regenerate by absorbing blood.
d7ab3d29: What is the kekkei genkai of the Kaguya clan?
Shikotsumyaku lets members of the Kaguya clan control their bones at will and turn them into weapons.
c7f253cc: What is the name of Naruto and Hinata's son?
Boruto Uzumaki is Naruto and Hinata's eldest child. He is the protagonist of the Boruto series.
241b232b: What is the name of Boruto's sister?
Himawari Uzumaki is Naruto and Hinata's younger daughter. She once activated her Byakugan by accident.
9878ed01: Who is the Tsuchikage in the original Naruto series?
Ōnoki, the old man, is the Third Tsuchikage of the Stone Village. He masters Dust Release (Jinton).
91c13f87: What is Ōnoki's Dust Release technique called?
Jinton (Dust Release) lets Ōnoki disintegrate everything it touches into powder. It is a kekkei tōta (three natures combined).
c00fd5dc: What is the real name of Kakashi's Mangekyō technique?
Kamui is Kakashi's Mangekyō technique. It creates a space-time distortion that pulls targets into another dimension.
22501231: What is special about Hashirama Senju's chakra?
Hashirama masters Wood Release (Mokuton), which lets him create and control trees, and even tame tailed beasts.
a3215cea: What is the final arc of Naruto Shippuden?
The Fourth Great Ninja War is the final arc, pitting the Allied Shinobi Forces against the Akatsuki and its reanimated fighters.
ce64e2e6: Kaguya can teleport between dimensions and absorb any chakra. She is the progenitor of chakra.
a558bc85: How many tailed beasts exist in the Naruto universe?
There are nine tailed beasts, from the One-Tail (Shukaku) to the Nine-Tailed Fox (Kurama).
d16eda66: Which jutsu does Orochimaru use to transfer his soul into a new body?
Living Corpse Reincarnation lets Orochimaru transfer his soul into a new body every three years.
a9b3f236: What is the secret group Danzō founded within the Leaf Village?
Root (Ne) is a secret Anbu division led by Danzō Shimura, operating in the shadows.
6a96d377: Naruto's element is Wind (Fūton), which lets him create the Rasenshuriken by combining wind and the Rasengan.
4608d6d9: What is the name of the ultimate genjutsu Madara casts on all of humanity?
The Infinite Tsukuyomi is cast through the Ten-Tails' eye reflected on the moon, trapping humanity.
8a991351: Who seals Kaguya at the end of the series?
Naruto and Sasuke, with the powers given to them by Hagoromo, use the Six Paths to seal Kaguya again.
f8679133: Who does Sasuke want to kill throughout the first part of the series?
Sasuke devotes his life to killing Itachi, his older brother, whom he believes responsible for the massacre of his clan.
2a5e1b8f: Who was the jinchūriki of Isobu, the Three-Tailed Beast?
Yagura, the Fourth Mizukage of the Mist, was the jinchūriki of Isobu, the Three-Tails shaped like a giant turtle.
